thread:
Alex Chen: ok taking 2 min to hand off. I'm ending my primary shift (11:00-15:00). TL;DR: saw transient errors in eu-west for text-gen route, mitigated with a config rollback, created follow-ups. Primary -> Maria as secondary takes over as primary now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: #INC-4492 triggered 2024-06-04T12:02:14Z — error rate spike on /v1/generate (eu-west) — sev2 — paged oncall at 12:03 UTC

Alex Chen: timeline quick: 12:01 error bump (2.8%->6.2%), 12:04 autoscaler started new nodes but they weren't joining due to ASG tagging bug, 12:10 rolled back the last autoscaling-config change (reverted tag filter), 12:14 error rate back to baseline ~0.6%. No customer-visible data loss, but 2% requests returned 502 briefly.

Maria Gomez: taking over as primary. thanks. any ongoing alerts?

Alex Chen: no active pages now. Cloudwatch alarm for EU gateway (eu-gen-502) is still firing low freq, monitoring. I left a brief runbook pointer in the thread: runbook -> https://confluence.redwood/company/runbooks/oncall-text-gen (see section "eu autoscale tag mismatch")

Jamal Wright: noted. Can you paste the rollback command you ran?

Alex Chen: sure — command I ran (kubectl wrapper):
```
./infractl autoscaler update --asg-filter "tag:env=prod,tag:region=eu-west" --apply --rollback-to 2024-05-30-12
```
That re-applied previous ASG filter. Also manually restarted the joiner service on 3 nodes: `systemctl restart redwood-joiner` on node ids i-0a1b2c3d 

Sarah Lee: did we create a ticket for a permanent fix? sounds like root cause is our deployment job dropped the tag on recent scale policy change.

Alex Chen: created follow-up INC ticket and a JIRA: TICKET-5832 (autoscaler: ensure tag filter tests + CI gate). Linked in incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TICKET-5832

incident-bot: Ticket created: TICKET-5832 by Alex Chen at 2024-06-04T13:00:12Z

Maria Gomez: ok switching roles — I'm now primary. Alex, can you confirm the handoff checklist?

Alex Chen: handed off checklist:
- Primary duties: respond to pages for text-gen, embeddings, and kv-cache ops
- Secondary duties: own dedicated infra escalations, pager escalation to SRE if >15m
- Known triage steps: check eu autoscaler alarms, verify ASG tags, check joiner logs at /var/log/redwood/joiner.log
- Short-term mitigations: rollback scale filter (done), scale-up manual if error >2% for 5m
- Follow-ups: TICKET-5832 (owner: jamal), schedule a retro (owner: sarah)

Jamal Wright: I got the owner for TICKET-5832. I'll start a small patch today to add a test-case and a deploy check. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Sarah Lee: scheduling retro — proposed 2024-06-06 16:00 UTC (30m) in #incident-retros. I'll send invite and agenda. Action items: root cause analysis, CI gate for autoscaler changes, add a runbook step to verify new autoscaler filters post-deploy.

Maria Gomez: quick note on coverage: next shift (15:00-19:00) only one oncall due to PTO (Tues). ops-rotations confirmed backup oncall is Jamal but if pager spikes >2 pages in 30m escalate to SRE on-call.

Alex Chen: small coverage gap: between 17:30-18:00 there's a meeting overlap with Jamal; recommend swapping with someone on rotations or make sure SRE is primed. ops-rotations, can you confirm?

ops-rotations: confirmed we have partial overlap. Reassigning 17:30-18:00 to Priya N. and adding her to the oncall list for that window.

Maria Gomez: thanks. Any customer-facing comms needed? We had small % of 502s for a few mins but no data loss. I don't think a public status update needed, but customer success flagged one app that saw retries. Alex, can you file a support note for CS?

Alex Chen: filed support note -> CS-2045 (internal), summary: brief 2-3 min 502 spike in eu-west for text-gen; advise customer to retry. Linked to INC-4492 and TICKET-5832.

Jamal Wright: adding runbook tweak PR: repo infra/runbooks/verify-asg-tags.md — will submit once tests added.

Sarah Lee: post-handoff follow-up checklist (I'll own):
- retro scheduled + invite (Sarah)
- RCA doc in confluence (Sarah)
- JIRA follow-ups: TICKET-5832 (Jamal), TICKET-5833 (runbook pr, assign Jamal), CS-2045 (Alex)
- verify coverage gap resolved before next week (ops-rotations)

Maria Gomez: all good from my side. I'll monitor for the next hour then drop to secondary. Thanks Alex for the handoff notes and quick rollback. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: thanks team. leaving notes in pager: `handoff: primary->Maria (12:30) inc-4492 resolved, followups TICKET-5832`

incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff logged at 2024-06-04T13:20:00Z by Alex Chen

Maria Gomez: closing thread, will reopen if anything else pops up.
